preconditions.description: The number of problems, n, must be between 1 and 5000.
The required balance, m, must be between 0 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output '-1'. Otherwise, output n integers representing the score distribution.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(score) <= 10**9 for score in return_value.split())
postconditions.description: Each score in the distribution must be a positive integer not exceeding 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(int(return_value.split()[i]) < int(return_value.split()[i+1]) for i in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: Scores must be in strictly increasing order.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n) for k in range(j+1, n) if int(return_value.split()[i]) + int(return_value.split()[j]) == int(return_value.split()[k])) == m
postconditions.description: The number of triples (i, j, k) such that a_i + a_j = a_k must be exactly m.
